name: the-hunt
description: THE HUNT — jeu de survie spatiale

scripts.web:copy: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.webmanifest sw.js www/ && cp -r css js icons www/
scripts.android:sync: npm run web:copy && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../THE-HUNT-debug.apk
